title: CLIO Claude Code model catalog
description: Schema for catalogs/claude-code-models.json, fetched by providers/model_discovery/claude_code_catalog.py. Mirrors the validation _parse_catalog already enforces at read time (schema_version, model id shape, capabilities vocabulary, default_model membership) so CI can catch a malformed commit before it ever reaches a client's fetch.

shipped_default_effort.description: CLIO's own default thinking level for this model (read by providers.capabilities.dialects.claude_code); never the model's own reported default.
